denseSourceBake: Each frame keyed linearly to preserve reference wall clearance; two arm widths, reversed down loop and mirrored sideways loop share parameters.
previewRootMotion: Only EntityTrajectory_PREVIEW_ONLY object moves for release/mantle; do not apply to game physics or duplicate entity movement. Other loops are in-place.
mantleBehavior: Existing collision-assisted forward/up movement at open ledge; lower arms and step over. No ledge grab, vault jump or new ability.
orientation: Body faces actual wall normal. Keep player camera free. Blend wall normals across existing corners; do not orient solely from camera yaw.
phaseDriver: Drive moving phase from actual displacement along the wall. Freeze/reset on hold, zero motion or blocked input. Do not run a moving loop just because a key is held.
timing: Reference 30 fps and lengths are art samples. Keep existing immediate gameplay activation and release; no animation gates.
stateEvidence: ClimbView currently only active/blocked target-only. Face, tangent, displacement, mantle and other-player state are not available in this packet. Actual integration needs extracted render state; no state or network implementation is included.
scope: six movement types; right is mirrored horizontal variation, down reverses vertical loop; no new first-person camera effect, skin, tool, climbing jump, rain slipping or environment asset.
contactLimit: Rigid limb extrema follow the proxy plane at source frames; production contact anchors and arbitrary block shapes need actual renderer integration. References do not prove world-space planted grip locking.
